description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFielduser_name class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldname. It provides a method displayInput to generate an HTML select element for choosing multiple user names, likely used in form layouts within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFielduser_name
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a user name selection input in CRM forms, extending SugarWidgetFieldname.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with multiple selection enabled, for choosing user names, using options provided by external functions.
